paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得过去四周一次整理文件时突然很害怕，活动因此中断，却不清楚变化从哪一刻开始，也不知道原因。另一段记忆只剩“那时不舒服”。两段可以保持不同清晰度，不要求拼成时间线，也不能从普通场景推出没有危险、身体无事或已经符合某种发作定义。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls sudden strong fear interrupting paper sorting during the past four weeks, without knowing its exact beginning or cause. Another recollection is only that the moment felt uncomfortable. Different clarity can remain without a reconstructed timeline. An ordinary setting establishes neither absence of danger, physical safety nor an attack definition.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我记得有过突然的强烈恐惧；起点、原因和部分细节仍不清楚；我现在只想说这些。”可以只读虚构卡，不作事件说明或询问别人是否也这样。听者不替经历命名，也不要求复述得更精确才承认顾虑值得讨论。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names remembered sudden strong fear, leaves its beginning, cause and some details unclear and limits what is shared now. Read the fictional card without an event account or asking others to compare experiences. A listener assigns no name to the episode and requires no more precise retelling before acknowledging a concern.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是PDSS、诊断、治疗或行为练习。20条仍按四组各五条保留六类记录；计数算描述，不算发作、天数或强度，未计分不补零。四个主题可以重叠，不组成发展阶段或因果链。原观察尚无独立验证、常模或中英文测量等值；任何组合不确定身体原因、危险或照护需要，不延后已有专业意见与合适评估。四篇全文和支持说明不以作答解锁；复制仅含公开标题与入口，不含选择、计数或私人经历。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not PDSS, diagnosis, treatment or a behavioral exercise. Twenty descriptions retain four six-category records of five. Counts concern descriptions, not attacks, days or intensity; unscored is not zero. Overlapping topics form neither stages nor a causal chain. The original observations lack independent validation, norms or established English–Chinese measurement equivalence. No pattern settles physical causes, danger or care needs. Do not use it to postpone appropriate assessment or alter existing professional advice. All four guides and support information need no answers. Copying contains only the public title and entry, without selections, counts or private experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得害怕时也有令自己担心的身体感觉，另一个时刻则只记得可怕想法，先后不清。记录可以分别描述已记得与未知，不从同时出现推断哪项造成哪项，也不拿已有解释判断新情况。阅读例子无需留意当下身体、重现感觉或证明担心有无根据。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls a worrying bodily feeling alongside fear and, on another occasion, only a frightening thought; sequence is unclear. Remembered details and unknowns can remain separate. Co-occurrence establishes no cause, and an existing explanation assesses no new experience. Reading requires no present body attention, recreated sensation or proof for or against a concern.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡分开“记得注意到什么”“当时想到什么”“仍不知道什么”。可以只谈虚构例子，不填写症状细节。听者不把想法当已发生事实，不把身体感觉解释成只是焦虑；提问可以停在想了解哪些事，而不先接受一个诊断或安心保证。
paragraphs.en: An optional card separates what was noticed, what came to mind and what remains unknown. Discuss only the fictional example without supplying symptom details. A listener treats no thought as an established event and no bodily feeling as only anxiety. A question can begin with what needs understanding without first accepting a diagnosis or reassurance.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者过去四周想到更早的一段恐惧，担心再次出现，却无法回想当前时段是否有突然变化；另一人记得突然害怕，但没有同样的预先担心。两种描述不需要互相校正，也不组成阶段或再发概率。例子不要求追查旧经历、证伪担心或参加活动作检验。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader worries during the past four weeks about fear experienced earlier but cannot recall a sudden change in the current period. Another recalls sudden fear without the same anticipation. Neither account corrects the other or forms a stage or recurrence probability. The examples require no investigation of old events, disproving worry or attendance as a test.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“近期在意的是会不会再来；想到的经历可能更早；我不知道这意味着什么。”可以只读，不记录每次担心，也不争辩它合理与否。听者不要求本月先有一次经历，不给再发概率，更不以保证“不会再来”作为回应。
paragraphs.en: An optional card names recent concern about recurrence, acknowledges that the recalled experience may be older and leaves its meaning unknown. Read without tracking every worry or debating its legitimacy. A listener requires no episode this month, supplies no recurrence probability and offers no promise that it cannot happen again.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得一次担心强烈恐惧而希望有人陪同，另一次改变计划也涉及时间和无障碍条件。他不需要选出唯一原因。相同类别可以覆盖不同背景，不证明陪同多余、取消必要或参加安全，也不要求再出行、减少支持或用出席证明自己能应对。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls wanting company because of concern about feeling intense fear again, while another changed plan also involved timing and accessibility. No single cause must be chosen. A shared category can cover different circumstances without establishing unnecessary company, necessary cancellation or safe attendance. It assigns no further trip, reduced support or attendance as proof of coping.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我记得计划有过变化，也有几种实际考虑；有些背景我想保留；想讨论的是目前的顾虑。”可以只读，不透露路线、单位或陪伴者。听者不替人决定去留，不把支持当作失败，也不拿取消次数衡量健康或进步。
paragraphs.en: An optional card acknowledges a changed plan and several practical considerations, keeps some context private and names a current concern. Read without routes, workplaces or companions’ identities. A listener decides no attendance or departure, treats no support as failure and measures no health or progress by cancellations.
